subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should oversized workspace `IDENTITY.md` files fall back to no custom identity while explicit `openclaw agents set-identity --identity-file` imports fail with a diagnostic at the shared 2 MiB limit?
rationale: Bounding reads is technically sound, but choosing the observable compatibility behavior for previously unbounded files is an upgrade-policy decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt the bounded contract
options.body: Keep the shared 2 MiB cap, workspace null fallback, and explicit-import diagnostic so oversized content never reaches the identity parser.

options.title: Preserve explicit no-data behavior
options.body: Keep the cap but have oversized explicit imports behave like absent identity data instead of returning a command error.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared 2 MiB cap, workspace null fallback, and explicit-import diagnostic so oversized content never reaches the identity parser.
